product_consequences: AG route qualification must distinguish a declared mailbox, a manually callable inbox poll, a scheduled poll, and true event-driven mailbox-to-decision ingress.
A qualified machine route must prove that untrusted inbound content can reach a bounded AG fetch-or-verify action under an explicit execution policy.
Machine-use evidence requires a thread-preserving, durable identity-bound result; model text, echo output and in-process state are insufficient.
Repeated identity-bound arrival at an x402 challenge without settlement remains the measured commercial obstruction.
